revenueDefinition: Gross sales recorded in the store's Shopify admin, less refunds and cancellations, excluding sales tax and shipping charged to customers.

qualifyingConditions.title: Launch within 7 days of handover
qualifyingConditions.detail: Your first ad campaign goes live within 7 days of the handover call. The {periodDays}-day period starts the day it goes live.

qualifyingConditions.title: Follow the provided ad creative schedule
qualifyingConditions.detail: Run the supplied creatives in the order and rotation set out in the {periodDays}-day creative schedule. Campaigns are not paused for more than 48 consecutive hours.

qualifyingConditions.title: Maintain a minimum ad spend of $50 per day
qualifyingConditions.detail: Spend an average of at least $50 per day on Meta and/or TikTok ads across the {periodDays} days, with no single day below $35.

qualifyingConditions.title: Keep the store as it was handed over
qualifyingConditions.detail: Pricing, checkout, product catalogue and supplier stay as delivered. Prices are not cut by more than 10% and the theme is not replaced.

qualifyingConditions.title: Fulfil every order through the provided supplier
qualifyingConditions.detail: Orders are placed with the supplier within 48 hours of purchase so customers are not refunded for late dispatch.

qualifyingConditions.title: Give us read-only access for the period
qualifyingConditions.detail: EcomCla keeps staff-level read access to Shopify and the ad accounts for the {periodDays} days so revenue can be verified without screenshots.

exclusions.title: Ad account restrictions caused by your changes
exclusions.detail: Restrictions or bans that follow edits you make to creatives, ad copy, targeting, billing details or page ownership.

exclusions.title: Days the store was offline or out of stock by your action
exclusions.detail: Periods where the store was password-protected, paused, unpublished, or products were deactivated or set to zero inventory by you.

exclusions.title: Businesses resold or materially changed
exclusions.detail: Any business transferred, resold, merged into another store or rebranded during the guarantee period.

exclusions.title: Payment processor holds you trigger
exclusions.detail: Reserves, holds or payout delays caused by your own payment-processor setup, policies or verification status. Sales still count as revenue.

exclusions.title: Purchases made outside EcomCla checkout
exclusions.detail: Businesses bought through a private arrangement with the seller, or paid for by any method other than EcomCla checkout and escrow.

exclusions.title: Claims submitted after the claim window
exclusions.detail: Claims received more than {claimWindowDays} days after the {periodDays}-day period ends, or without the evidence listed below.

claimProcess.title: Submit a claim
claimProcess.detail: Use the contact form and choose "Guarantee claim", within {claimWindowDays} days of the end of your {periodDays}-day period.

claimProcess.title: Send the evidence
claimProcess.detail: Attach the items listed under Evidence. Your buyer success manager will confirm receipt within one business day.

claimProcess.title: We verify
claimProcess.detail: We check revenue and conditions using the read-only access you granted. Review takes up to {reviewTimeBusinessDays} business days, and we tell you the outcome in writing.

claimProcess.title: Assets come back
claimProcess.detail: If approved, the store, domain, social accounts and creatives transfer back to EcomCla. We send a checklist and handle the transfer with you on a call.

claimProcess.title: You are refunded
claimProcess.detail: The full purchase price is returned to the original payment method within {refundTimingBusinessDays} business days of the assets transferring back.

evidenceRequired: Shopify Sales over time report covering the {periodDays}-day period, exported as CSV
Ad spend report from each ad platform used, by day, for the same dates
Confirmation of the campaign start date (the first ad's delivery date)
A note of any days campaigns were paused, and why
